name: Netherlands waterways (inland and coastal)
description: Navigable route network for the Netherlands: inland waterways, IJsselmeer, Wadden Sea, Delta and coastal approaches, based on Rijkswaterstaat IENC / ENC data, NWB vaarwegen, VNDS and BRTN. Waterway centre lines with depth limits, bridges and locks with clearances, tidal regimes, and connections to harbours and marinas. Not for navigation: verify against official charts and notices.
